title: dkim.key_seed_b64 secretx URI fails validation — unusable in both smtp and reader
description: Three-layer bug affecting both smtp and reader. (1) smtp/src/config.rs validate() line 570 and reader/src/config.rs validate() line 774 both unconditionally base64-decode key_seed_b64 without checking for a secretx:// prefix — so any secretx URI fails Config::from_file with 'invalid base64' before secretx resolution runs. (2) smtp/src/main.rs resolves secretx for delivery.dkim.key_seed_b64 AFTER Config::from_file (lines 159-176), but from_file already failed. (3) reader/src/store/server_stores.rs build_smtp_relay_queue has no secretx resolution at all. Net result: smtp_relay.dkim.key_seed_b64 and delivery.dkim.key_seed_b64 cannot be set to secretx:// URIs despite secretx being supported for every other secret field. The validate() checks must skip base64 decode when the value starts with 'secretx:' (defer decode until after resolution, as the smtp relay peer password validation does).
